purpose: Execution record for the five requested measured-data follow-ups. Public metadata, sensor-family capability, inferred units and inaccessible payloads do not increase accepted counts.

The aggregate runner remained fail-closed with zero accepted samples.
actions.decision: Keep RWTH unprofiled until the publisher endpoint delivers the archive or the publisher supplies the exact file through another authoritative route.

checks: Two mould-temperature and two cavity-pressure channels are already accepted, contributing 1,188,348 measured values.
The PASCOE instrumentation and machine-learning papers identify the 4262A hydraulic-pressure, P510 screw-position, 4021B nozzle-temperature and 6188A cavity sensors.
The 4262A family supports multiple pressure ranges, units and electrical outputs, so the sensor model alone cannot define the delivered CSV scaling.
HydPressure, ScrewPosition and Analog Input[1]/[2] still lack authoritative export units/scaling and stable stage-to-sensor mappings.
actions.decision: Retain the four resolved physical channels and keep the four unresolved columns non-counting pending the prepared author clarification request.
